decisions.thought: Opponent has Dragapult (fast), Gholdengo, Incineroar, Garganacl, Dragonite (Multiscale?), Azumarill. Bring Garchomp lead (Earthquake hits Incineroar/Gholdengo, Fire Fang for Garganacl). Gholdengo blocks status, walls Garganacl. Primarina checks Dragonite/Azumarill. Watch for their Dragapult outspeeding most of my team.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Pick 3. Opponent likely: Gholdengo, Dragapult, Dragonite, Incineroar, Garganacl, Azumarill. My picks: Gholdengo (blocks status, good vs their team), Kingambit (dark, strong), Garchomp (ground for Incineroar/steels). Or Primarina for Dragonite/Azumarill. Dragapult theirs is fast threat; my Dragapult with sash can check.

I'll bring Garchomp lead, Gholdengo, Kingambit? Azumarill/Dragonite worry. Primarina handles Dragonite (fairy) and Azumarill. Maybe Gholdengo, Primarina, Garchomp. Kingambit strong vs Gholdengo/Dragapult. Hmm.

Team: Gholdengo (leader?), Garchomp, Primarina. Kingambit is great vs Gholdengo/Dragapult/Incineroar. I'd take Kingambit over Primarina? Dragonite Multiscale threatens. Primarina resists dragon, handles Azumarill.

Choose: Garchomp lead, Kingambit, Primarina. But Gholdengo good vs Garganacl? Garganacl salt cure... Gholdengo immune to status/toxic. Garganacl likely body press/curse — Gholdengo can't be poisoned, resists rock? No, rock neutral vs steel... Steel resists rock. Good.

Final: Garchomp, Gholdengo, Primarina.

No—Good as Gold only blocks status targeting them, Calm Mind targets self, but boosting while they attack is risky. Chip Gholdengo with Aria; keep Garchomp healthy for Incineroar/Garganacl cleanup. Dragonite +1 still a threat—Primarina handles it.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo immune to status (Good as Gold blocks Calm Mind? No—Good as Gold blocks status moves targeting it; Calm Mind targets self, fine). Sparkling Aria neutral on Steel/Ghost? Water vs Steel resisted? Steel resists Water? No, Water is neutral vs Steel. Ghost neutral. So neutral. Moonblast resisted (Steel resists Fairy? Steel resists Fairy yes). Sparkling Aria with Mystic Water ~decent. Stay in, hit with Aria.
